centrifuge/v1.title: Bench centrifuge
centrifuge/v1.description: Four slots require zero, two opposite, or four tubes. Visual speed capped at 60 rpm; rotor stops on a whole revolution.

preconditions.message: Wait for the rotor to stop before opening the lid

start.description: Run then decelerate; imbalanced rejects nonopposite loading.

preconditions.message: The lid is open; call closeLid first

robot-arm/v1.title: Robot arm
robot-arm/v1.description: Joint-space taught positions are assumed safe; no collision detection. Virtual geometry is a simplified kinematic arm, not a Newton reachability proof.

pick.description: Pick a tube; location_empty, grasp_failed, motion_timeout may be returned.

place.description: Place the held tube; place_failed or motion_timeout may be returned.

pickPlace.description: Pick then place; location_empty, grasp_failed, place_failed, motion_timeout may be returned.

closeLid.message: Move the arm out of the centrifuge zone first
